Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Quality and OEM Standards: All supplied IT equipment, peripherals, hardware, and related consuma bles must be 100% genuine, brand new, and manufactured by reputed Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). The supply of refurbished, duplicate, counterfeit, or unbranded products is strictly prohibited. The buyer reserves the right to verify the product's authenticity and serial numbers directly with the respective OEM. 2. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): If the bidder is not the Original Equipment Manufacturer ( OEM), they must invariably upload a valid and bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) from th e OEM. Bids without a valid MAF will be technically disqualified to prevent the supply of counterfeit goods. 3. Compatibility and Performance: All supplied IT hardware, peripherals, and consumables must be ful ly compatible with standard institutional IT infrastructure and operating systems. The products must delive r optimal performance without causing any hardware conflicts or system errors. 4. Fresh Stock for Consumables: Any IT consumables supplied under this contract must be from a fres h manufacturing batch. Dried-up, expired, near-expiry, or refilled/remanufactured consumables will be im mediately rejected and returned at the supplier's risk and cost. 5. Comprehensive Warranty and Support: The supplied items must carry a minimum comprehensive onsite warranty as per the standard OEM policy (minimum 1 year, unless specified otherwise in the BOQ). I n case of any technical defect, hardware failure, or malfunction, the supplier/OEM must repair or replace th e defective unit within 48 to 72 hours of reporting, at no additional cost to the buyer. 6. Safe Delivery and Transit Damage: The bidder shall be fully responsible for the safe delivery of the f ragile IT goods. Any physical damage, breakage, or missing parts found during the unboxing and physical i nspection (CRAC) will be the sole responsibility of the seller, and immediate replacement must be provided . 7. Right to Reject and Cancel: The Buyer reserves the right to cancel the bid/contract at any stage with
out assigning any reason or to reject the supplied goods if they fail to meet the required technical parame ters or institutional quality standards. .
